title: Children’s Pajamas Recalled by Star Ride Kids Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,000.

title: CoScentrix Expands Recall of DD Brand Candles Due to Fire Hazard; Exclusively at Hobby Lobby
summary: The candle's high flame can ignite the surface of the wax, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 168,000 (About 256,000 candles sold in jars and tins were recalled in November 2014 and about 126,000 candles sold in tins were recalled in April 2014).

title: Pro Performance Recalls SKLZ Resistance Trainers Due to Risk of Severe Injury
summary: A weld on a ring on the resistance trainer's belt can break during use and cause the resistance trainer's flexible cord to quickly and unexpectedly retract and hit an exercise partner who is holding the other end. Units: About 52,000.

title: Hunters’ Tree Stands Recalled by Primal Vantage Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cast aluminum platform can break, causing the user to fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 1,000.

title: Johnson Health Tech Recalls Matrix Fitness Strength Training Machines Due to Risk of Impact Injury, Laceration and Fall Hazards
summary: The handle attachment on the strength training machines can detach during use and hit the user with force and/or cause the user to lose balance and fall. This poses a risk of impact injury, laceration and fall hazards. Units: About 140.

title: CR Brands Recalls Mean Green Cleaner and Degreaser Products Due to Chemical Hazard
summary: The products are labeled "Does not contain Ammonia." The products may contain ammonia. The mislabeling of the bottles can pose a chemical hazard to consumers. If ammonia is mixed with bleach or other household chemicals, irritating or toxic gases could be produced. Units: About 83,800.

title: La-Z-Boy Recalls Control Wands Sold With Silver Luxury Lift Chairs Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wand that controls the chair's movements can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: NPD Furniture Recalls Dining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Chair legs can break unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 250.

title: IKEA Recalls Crib Mattresses Due to Risk of Entrapment
summary: The crib mattresses could create a gap between the mattress and crib ends larger than allowed by federal regulations, posing an entrapment hazard to infants. Units: About 169,000.

title: Sunbeam Recalls Holmes Oil Filled Heaters Due to Scald Hazard
summary: The oil-filled heaters can spray heated oil, posing a scald hazard. Units: About 34,000 in United States.

title: Vosges Haut-Chocolat Recalls Festival of Lights Gift Box Sets Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The plastic menorah can catch fire if candles are allowed to burn to the base of the menorah. Units: About 250.

title: Mirka Extends Recall of Compact Electric Random Orbital Sanders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sander can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 574 in the U.S. and 21 in Canada (About 440 in the U.S. and 85 in Canada were previously recalled in June 2014.).
